shortDescription: Customer portal intermittently returns 502 during account lookup
description: ServiceNow ticket says several call-centre users report that customer account lookup fails intermittently. Some retries succeed. No confirmed outage banner yet.
callerNotes: Two users reported 502 from the portal around 09:05-09:10. One user says the same customer works after retrying.

evidence.summary: Call-centre reports intermittent 502 errors during customer account lookup.
